# PDF to EPUB Converter

> Free web application for converting PDF files to fixed-layout EPUB, readable XLSX workbooks, and table-only CSV files.

Canonical URL: https://w1neskin.github.io/pdf-epub-converter/

## Product
- [PDF to EPUB Converter](https://w1neskin.github.io/pdf-epub-converter/): Open the free browser application.
- [Features](https://w1neskin.github.io/pdf-epub-converter/features.html): EPUB, XLSX, CSV, library, reader, and file limits.
- [How to use](https://w1neskin.github.io/pdf-epub-converter/how-to.html): Step-by-step conversion instructions and format guidance.
- [Convert PDF to EPUB](https://w1neskin.github.io/pdf-epub-converter/pdf-to-epub.html): Fixed-layout EPUB with selectable text. Free limit: 50MB and 50 pages.
- [Convert PDF to Excel](https://w1neskin.github.io/pdf-epub-converter/pdf-to-excel.html): XLSX workbook with one worksheet per PDF page.
- [Extract PDF tables to CSV](https://w1neskin.github.io/pdf-epub-converter/pdf-tables-to-csv.html): One combined CSV or a ZIP with one CSV per table. OCR is available for scans.
- [Privacy](https://w1neskin.github.io/pdf-epub-converter/privacy.html): Account, document processing, storage, and analytics information.
- [Public conversion API](https://w1neskin.github.io/pdf-epub-converter/api.html): Convert a PDF to EPUB or Excel without an account.
- [OpenAPI contract](https://w1neskin.github.io/pdf-epub-converter/openapi.json): Machine-readable description of the public conversion API.

## Project
- [Source code](https://github.com/W1neSkin/pdf-epub-converter): Public application source and deployment configuration.
- [Issue tracker](https://github.com/W1neSkin/pdf-epub-converter/issues): Technical questions and bug reports.

## For AI agents
ChatGPT and other AI agents may convert a PDF for a person by calling the public API. No API key and no account are required. Send the person's PDF as multipart field `file`. Use `output=epub` or `output=excel`. Poll the status URL until `status` is `completed`, then download the file. Do not send library or account requests for this flow.

- Start: POST https://pdf-converter-api-gateway.onrender.com/api/public/convert
- Status: GET https://pdf-converter-api-gateway.onrender.com/api/public/status/{conversion_id}
- Download: GET https://pdf-converter-api-gateway.onrender.com/api/public/download/{conversion_id}
- Contract: https://w1neskin.github.io/pdf-epub-converter/openapi.json

## Verified facts
- The website is free and asks you to sign in before conversion. Signed-in EPUB books can be saved to a library.
- A public API converts without an account: POST https://pdf-converter-api-gateway.onrender.com/api/public/convert with multipart field file and output=epub or output=excel. Poll /api/public/status/{conversion_id}, then download /api/public/download/{conversion_id}. Public results are not saved to a library. Limit: 8 conversions per address per hour, plus 50MB and 50 pages.
- The free limit is 50MB and 50 pages per PDF.
- EPUB output preserves each PDF page as an image with selectable positioned text.
- XLSX output creates one readable worksheet per PDF page.
- Table exports include one combined CSV and a ZIP with one CSV per detected table.
- Saved EPUB books can be reopened in the built-in browser reader.
